generations.name: First generation (G26)
generations.notes: Launch. 83.9 kWh gross / 81.5 kWh usable pack on eDrive40, xDrive40 and M50/M60; smaller 70.2 kWh gross (66 kWh usable) pack on eDrive35. The 2025 facelift (lights, trim) and the 2026 update (silicon-carbide inverters, more range, M50 renamed M60, eDrive35 dropped) kept the same 81 kWh pack. No pack change across 2022-2026, so one generation. The 2026 inverter change may shift efficiency but not the pack; no source says the DC peak changed. eDrive35 (smaller pack) was sold about 2023-2025 in North America. Wikipedia's navbox lists the i4 as discontinued and its infobox ends model years at 2026, but I found no official North American end date, so last_year is left open. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_i4 ; https://insideevs.com/news/778177/2026-bmw-i4-range-power/ ; https://www.press.bmwgroup.com/usa/article/detail/T0453773EN_US/2026-bmw-i4-update-measures
